svg.text: dense broadleaf and fir; a green floor; a leaf-litter ground
A. At fight distance, noon: the ground profile, the cover silhouettes, the far land as a value ladder. The two grey figures are 75 units tall (a fighter): scale only, no character art.
Palette at noon (the world-light tint per sky key multiplies it; lit, mid and shade are the three faces of one surface; the far ladder is each ridge hazed toward the horizon)

Readability (docs/art/dynamic-sky.md section 6): worst aura against any tone 21.4 CIEDE2000 (rule: 20 or more), worst Protagonist or rival body against ground, rock or vegetation 23.9 (rule: 15 or more), over every sky key with the world-light tint.
B. What the fight leaves: scorched (a beam along the ground), cratered (an impact), burned (fire on what grows)
a black band through the trees: trunks charred on one side, canopy singed
brown, the leaf litter burnt to black
a bowl of dark loam with a ring of felled trunks lying away from it like
a standing burn: black trunks with no leaves, orange-brown scorched canopy
at the edges, a grey ash floor

C. Destruction in temperate forest: the impact at three moments (burst, peak, settle). Leaf shred and splinters: green and orange leaf shards swirl, pale splinters and bark chunks arc out, a dark dirt cloud below.
D. Where it meets its neighbours (hard steps in colour, never a fade; the cover mixes over about a third of the width)

Temperate forest to Tundra and taiga
Broadleaf gives way to spruce; the trees shrink poleward; lichen and snow
The tree line climbs the slope: tall firs, then small firs, then scree and rock.
